139	Why? Because the whole matter is the strength and the courage
140	of the Jewish people, which casts fear and dread. And then there is
141	also Siyata Dishmaya, so that everything is done with the most
142	wondrous precision, which is a miracle clothed in nature that cannot be missed.

144	And here we find another very special thing: what is
145	the source in the Torah for a miracle clothed in nature? When one wants
146	to bring a source for miracles above nature, the source
147	is the splitting of the Red Sea and the ten plagues, where HaShem
148	shows His power in such a way that there is
149	nothing natural here, it is only a heavenly act. But
150	that is not the ultimate purpose. The ultimate purpose is that
151	the reality of nature be precious in the eyes of HaShem,
152	and that within nature the Divine power be revealed. Megillat Esther,
153	Megillat Esther, Persia: we are right now exactly located
154	in the very place that is the classic place that HaShem chose,
155	where the miracle clothed in nature will find expression
156	in nature.
